cases.name: sidecar_mls_bootstrap_binding
assertions: desired access transcript includes the controller and is sorted and unique
the SDK canonical helper is the only producer of desired_access_digest
Sidecar genesis uses the backing Circle effective scope and carries exact sidecar_binding
server-generated MLS private state and synthetic GroupInfo digests are forbidden
a concurrent losing provisional snapshot is destroyed

cases.name: sidecar_mls_effective_access
assertions: Circle membership without accepted Add Commit Welcome and target-device consume remains pending
one active authorized Agent device with matching evidence makes the Agent principal effective
current controller device readiness is evaluated separately from effective_agent_ids
desired access removal stops delivery before the Remove Commit lands
the Principal Server creates a removal obligation but never fabricates an MLS Commit
the dedicated Sidecar view exposes a sorted non-empty removal membership_frontier without exposing the backing Circle through ordinary Circle surfaces
the controller persists signed Remove events and advances its post-commit snapshot only after accepted submission

cases.name: sidecar_ensure_idempotent
assertions: ensure operation id remains ak.self.agent.sidecar.command.ensure
ensure capability action matches the operation id
ensure returns sidecar_id and never private_circle_id
backing Circle canonical shape and reserved SC- prefix remain enforced
sidecar profile id remains ak.profile.agent_sidecar.v1

cases.name: sidecar_eligibility_states
assertions: paused agents are excluded from desired sidecar access
deactivated agents are excluded and trigger backing-scope MLS removal
desired and effective access remain distinct until reconciliation completes
default home policy remains context_realm_preferred

cases.name: sidecar_existence_privacy
assertions: callers without sidecar ensure capability receive sidecar_create_denied
sidecar and backing Circle existence are not disclosed via distinct branches

cases.name: sidecar_hosted_projection
assertions: track_name and message_id are rejected in ensure context_ref
one private Strand is reused across all source Strand Tracks
display mode is encrypted per-context view state and defaults to context_merged
each source-routed exchange has an independent device-local Event-fold cache and stable anchor order
sidecar-native events create no source echo
merged projection deduplicates the private request Event by Event id

cases.name: sidecar_multi_agent_publish
assertions: ensure, write, exchange control, and publish capability actions all remain Agent Sidecar scoped
the sidecar capability action quartet contains no duplicates and exchange control is controller-only

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_binding_closed_loop
assertions: the routed request event carries a role=request binding with a full request_context, completion_policy=coordinator, and a valid coordinator assignment
the agent runtime learns the exchange identity only from the decrypted request binding; exchange projection is never Account Data or an account-stream object
the runtime executes only when its own principal is addressed, active, eligible, effective, MLS-ready, the Event is the canonical request for exchange_id, and that exchange_id is not already consumed
the runtime persists exchange_id to canonical request_event_id; a later request Event reusing the same exchange_id fails closed and cannot execute again

a validated role=user_facing_response binding with matching exchange_id, request_event_id, causal request ref, private strand, scope, and addressed actor is the only path into user_facing_response_event_ids
the accepted request folds to delivered; validated role=internal events keep that state and stay non-echo without producing errors
wrong exchange_id, wrong request_event_id, wrong private strand, missing causal ref, non-addressed actor, unknown role, and ak:message: shaped request references all fail closed to non-echo
a role=request binding on an agent-authored event is invalid and never consumed
duplicate delivery of the same response event id appends exactly once and the response set keeps canonical (event HLC, event id) byte order

a non-coordinator completes_exchange request never closes the exchange; a valid coordinator request causes the controller to author a durable close control Event, and only that Event advances terminal state

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_projection_recovery
assertions: after local cache loss the controller rebuilds from accepted private Event history without redelivering the agent request
agent-authored role=request bindings are excluded from rebuild by consumer-side actor validation
independent controller devices replaying validation over the same private history produce bit-identical response sets, canonical order, and status
incomparable local folded frontiers are never resolved by HLC or LWW; devices backfill and fold the joined accepted history
folded_frontier carries canonical maximal causal heads, a digest of all contributing Event ids, and max HLC; it is local cache validation metadata only
close or cancel with a non-empty captured response set produces complete; close empty produces controller_closed_empty and cancel empty produces controller_cancelled
agent or control events concurrent with and not causally covered by the winning terminal basis remain private audit history but do not enter the terminal projection

same-sequence control siblings use event-digest bytewise maximum, the first effective terminal control absorbs later controls, and reassignment is valid only before terminal with a matching expected coordinator
delivered requires empty responses, responding/complete require non-empty responses, failed requires empty responses plus failure_code, and non-failed states forbid failure_code

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_binding_containment
assertions: plaintext metadata carrying sidecar_exchange_binding, the binding schema id, or an exchange_id value is a schema_violation hard reject on the wire
binding or control plaintext decrypted from a non-Sidecar scope is invalid and never rendered or folded
explicit publish output is an ordinary shared event carrying no binding, exchange_id, sidecar_id, or private locator
publish output, shared history, Account Data, push previews, notifications, and public telemetry have zero hits for exchange_id, binding schema id, and control schema id
